authority: Roger 2026-11-08 E15 看片（SUPERVISOR_ORDERS seq=219）：打斗不像专业武侠；E15 VU-020 三次重投都在兵器相接后定格 1.75–2.0 s
activation_note: Offline compile-time policy (no provider call). Active from E16 onward, or when the writing contract declares combat_motion_policy=COMBAT_MOTION_V1 (set for E15's rework once its beats are authored as ladders). Old episodes keep the legacy state template byte-for-byte.

renderer.replaces: the state template (Start from / Force origin / primary action / Interaction mode / primary feedback / End at) for a COMBAT beat that carries a ladder
renderer.keeps: the beat's timing bracket, the entry state as a one-line 'Open from', and the coverage facts (entry/exit/contact) so the semantic coverage gate still finds them

rules.CM1: one move per shot: the strike, its reception and its displacement are separate shots, each 0.5–1.5 s
rules.CM2: every shot names the body part met and the direction and distance moved (刀面/矛杆/护臂/肩 + 画左/画右/前/后 + 半尺/一臂/半步)
rules.CM3: a segment really makes contact once: at most one contact shot in the ladder
rules.CM4: a contact shot is at most 0.4 s — longer than that the model holds the two weapons together
rules.CM5: the last shot's result is an ongoing move, never a settled pose; the words 顶住/咬住/僵持/撑住/停住/hold/lock are blocked in a shot result
rules.CM6: consecutive shots never share scale and camera side: the cut, not the camera move, carries the change

evidence.e15_vu020: three takes, three freezes: 2.0 s, 1.75 s, 2.0 s of blade resting on shaft after the first contact; every take had to be trimmed in S7 to pass combat_execution_check
evidence.e15_weapon_shape: the same sabre renders as a thin straight sword, a curved sabre, a broad blade and a short cleaver across VU-018..021
